title: The Alibi of Greywater Bay
author: Sebastian Nystrom
blurb: Theo Ashgrove, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the trial begins.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
